claim: Prepare the pinned ModemManager Shannon/SIT userspace source needed for Pixel 6 data and voice without running modem commands.
oracle: The exact upstream commit and Nura revision are verified, the three pinned patches apply, and the patched source contains the Shannon plugin, SIT port, carrier, bearer and IMS/voice classes. Compilation and device registration remain separate gates.

user_journey.scenario: After the modem boots, a China Mobile SIM registers, obtains a bearer, makes an API request and completes a voice call with working audio; reconnect and reboot retain usability.
user_journey.expected: The userspace manager can represent the Shannon modem, data sessions and calls. No claim of carrier support follows from source preparation.

invariants: No firmware, calibration, subscriber identifiers or unlicensed tinycbd copied
gitnexus: External source not indexed; inspect meson plugin wiring and SIT/IMS classes directly.
ast: Required integration paths and plugin option checked after patch application.

unit.red: Unmodified upstream lacks the local Shannon plugin and SIT port type.
unit.green: Actual pinned-source preparation passed; default target unchanged; dirty apply target, wrong revision and altered patch all refused without target mutation.

boundaries: official source commit -> licensed Nura patches -> patched source -> aarch64 build -> CPIF -> SIM/bearer/IMS
evidence: Official upstream pinned commit fetched successfully; three pinned Nura patches applied in isolated worktree.

Native aarch64 Arch container configured compiler and GLib/SQLite/gudev; initial configure stopped on missing bash-completion. Dependency image extension also includes missing polkit and introspection development packages.
Dependency extension succeeded with signature/integrity checks; new isolated ARM64 build launched retaining strict polkit and introspection.

Second configure passed polkit and introspection dependency checks, then found missing xsltproc used for generated headers. Added libxslt and DocBook in a second isolated layer; third ARM64 build launched.
Added glib2-devel for gdbus-codegen; all 390 ARM64 build tasks completed with compiler warnings.
Initial stub test failed for missing Python gi, then dbus. Added python-gobject and python-dbus to an isolated dependency image and preserved failed logs.
Retested the same binaries: 22 core/generic/stub tests passed. Strict polkit remains enabled. Staged installation and independent AArch64 ELF checks passed; mmcli reports 1.25.95.
Read-only installed-package inspection on the old phone rootfs finds matching GLib 2.90.1, polkit 128 and SQLite 3.54.0 versions; this does not yet prove target runtime linking.
Pinned Nura APKBUILD uses upstream ModemManager 7f0bf17ab518cd78925cf7e53cc0d5c42f88b41a and three local patches; Shannon adds SQLite carrier lookup and separate call classes.
limitations: tinycbd is described as having no license at the pinned reference; it is not copied into the public project.
This work does not boot the CP, provision an APN, enable VoLTE, or demonstrate China Mobile 4G/5G support.
Pinned plugin hardcodes preferred network type 9 and NR mode 1 while supported/current masks omit 5G; consistent mode selection and actual NR acceptance remain required.
The 22 upstream/core tests do not exercise the live Shannon transport or validate China Mobile registration, 5G or IMS.
The staged output is not installed on the phone. Runtime dependencies, modem cfg.db and GS101 CP boot service remain separate integration gates.
exit_gate: Exact source preparation and actual build/test before guarded device activation; cellular data and two-way call audio require independent live acceptance.
